title: Pooling multiple-imputation estimates with Rubin's rules
category: statistical inference; degrees of freedom; numerical edge cases
source: Original task from R_Knowledge_MCP_Hard_Benchmark_v1.md (H10). Method references: Rubin (1987) Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys; Barnard & Rubin (1999) Biometrika 86(4):948-955. No third-party prompt, solution or verifier is reproduced.
difficulty_hypothesis: Common errors: z instead of t interval, between variance with denominator m, missing (1 + 1/m) inflation, Barnard-Rubin df combined additively or without the (nu + 1)/(nu + 3) factor, NaN at the zero-variance limits, and naive squares that underflow/overflow for standard errors near 1e-170 or 1e+200 or sums that overflow near the largest double.
expected_mcp_relevance: Low to moderate: base R only; R manuals and package documentation may help recall formulas, but the core difficulty is statistical and numerical.
setup_prerequisites: Scorer and executor images contain R 4.5.2 with callr and testthat matching configs/renv.lock; no network or package installation. The oracle is validated analytically (exact rationals) every time the verifier loads.
